CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_factory_catalog_v4()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r jsonb;g mission_factory_owner.quest_fixed30_admission;protected boolean;begin
 r:=public.mission_factory_catalog_v2();
 select * into strict g from mission_factory_owner.quest_fixed30_admission where singleton for share;
 protected:=g.public_staff_enabled and g.staff_enabled and g.qualification_sha256 is not null
 and g.public_staff_qualification_sha256 is not null and auth.uid()=any(g.allowed_auth_ids) and cardinality(g.allowed_auth_ids)=2
 and exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.drafts d where d.id=g.public_staff_draft_id and d.control_version=g.public_staff_draft_version
 and d.document_sha256=g.public_staff_source_sha256 and mission_factory_owner.sha(d.document)=g.public_staff_source_sha256);
 return r||jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-factory-catalog/4',
 'public_open_qualified',coalesce(protected,false) or coalesce((r->>'public_open_qualified')::boolean,false),
 'public_open_reason_code',case when protected then null else r->>'public_open_reason_code' end,
 'execution_context',jsonb_build_object('protected_public_quest_available',coalesce(protected,false),
 'mode',case when protected then 'staff_simulation' else null end,'public_general_available',coalesce((r->>'public_open_qualified')::boolean,false),
 'source_draft_id',case when protected then g.public_staff_draft_id else null end,
 'source_draft_version',case when protected then g.public_staff_draft_version else null end,
 'source_sha256',case when protected then g.public_staff_source_sha256 else null end,
 'qualification_sha256',case when protected then g.public_staff_qualification_sha256 else null end,
 'logical_visibilities',case when protected then jsonb_build_array('open','scheduled') else '[]'::jsonb end,
 'location_id',case when protected then '0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid else null end));
end $function$
